# MD Studio

> Full Stack & AI Development Agency by Adil Hussain — India

MD Studio is a boutique software development agency founded and run by Adil Hussain, a Full Stack Developer and AI Engineer with 8+ years of experience. The agency delivers scalable web applications, AI agents, SaaS platforms, and mobile products for clients across India, the USA, UK, UAE, Canada, and Australia.

## About the Founder

**Adil Hussain** is a Full Stack Developer and AI Engineer based in India. He specializes in building production-ready AI agents using LangChain and GPT-4, scalable SaaS applications, and enterprise-grade web products. He has delivered 127+ projects with a 5.0 star average rating from 89+ clients worldwide.

## Services

MD Studio offers the following professional software development services:

- **Full Stack Web Development** — React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Python
- **AI Agent Development** — LangChain, GPT-4, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents
- **SaaS Platform Development** — subscription billing, multi-tenancy, dashboards
- **Mobile App Development** — React Native, Expo (iOS and Android)
- **API Development** — RESTful APIs, GraphQL, third-party integrations
- **Database Design** — PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Redis
- **Cloud & DevOps** — AWS, Vercel, Docker, CI/CD pipelines
- **UI/UX Design** — Figma design systems, component libraries
- **Business Automation** — workflow automation, custom CRMs
- **AI Integration** — embedding AI into existing products and workflows

## Technology Stack

**Frontend**: React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js  
**Backend**: Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, Django  
**AI/ML**: OpenAI GPT-4, LangChain, Pinecone, Hugging Face, LlamaIndex  
**Mobile**: React Native, Expo  
**Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Redis, Pinecone (vector)  
**Cloud**: AWS, Vercel, Fly.io, Railway, Docker  
**Tools**: GitHub Actions, Stripe, Twilio, SendGrid
